name: BudgetGuard

test_list.description: Exact integer hourly-rate estimation rounds fractional hours upward without floating point.
Simultaneous reservations account for outstanding reservations before admission.
Settling a reservation moves actual spend into monotonic spent cost; settled spend cannot be refunded or settled again.
A zero aggregate budget denies admission even when computed cost is zero.
Actual cost above the reserved cap is recorded, reported, and permanently halts further admission.
A terminal provider cost above its reservation is recorded and permanently blocks future admission.
An actual charge above the aggregate cap is recorded when representable and permanently blocks future admission.
When actual cost cannot be added without overflow, accounting remains intact and future admission is permanently blocked.
Checked multiplication, addition, and ceiling calculations return an error on overflow.

inputs.name: hourly_rate_micros
inputs.description: Exact cost rate in integer micro-USD per hour.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Maximum billable lifetime used for conservative admission.

inputs.name: budget_micros
inputs.description: Hard aggregate spend limit in micro-USD.

output_description: A reservation backed by shared synchronized accounting, or a typed denial/error.
